summary: During 2026-07-17 23:06:13 – 2026-07-17 23:06:26, a confirmed true-positive attack from 91.132.147.22 progressed through Credential Access and Collection. Confirmed activity included password spraying against three accounts, successful managed identity token acquisition via IMDS from webapp-vm-001 for Microsoft Graph, and repeated mailbox item access against procurement@contoso.com. Total observable events: 6.

representationNotes.commentary: The source names procurement@contoso.com as type Mailbox while ap-team@contoso.com and vendor-mgmt@contoso.com are type User. The attack graph uses the same mailbox identifier as a spray target and mailbox access target. This model preserves procurement@contoso.com as a mailbox entity and does not create a separate user entity because the source does not explicitly distinguish them.
The attack graph edge label 'accessed mailbox' was normalized to relationship kind 'accessed' because no mailbox-specific relationship kind exists in schema.

Four mailbox-access alerts are correlated to four OfficeActivity records, but the source does not map each alert to a specific OfficeActivity event. All four alerts reference the same set of mailbox-access events and evidence records.
The source states 'Total observable events: 6'. This model represents six timeline events and does not separately encode the count assertion beyond the summary.

Technique T1114.002 is supported by multiple OfficeActivity records, but the source table cites only the first 2026-07-17 23:06:18 record as the activity description. The technique entry references only ev3 to remain source-faithful.

Entity additional identifiers such as IPs, AppIds, vm name, resource URL, and resource IDs were represented as separate entities or captured in descriptions/evidence rather than preserved as a dedicated additionalIdentifiers field because schema does not provide one.
